_comment: Curated names for the 00-area parameters, consumed by sysex_param_table_tex.py.
confidence ESTABLISHED = the instrument or its published manual names this byte;
LIKELY = a hard match on value range or bit count, printed with a dagger;
anything weaker is left out of this file entirely rather than printed hedged.
basis must say what would have to be false for the name to be wrong.

20/03.basis: mixer strip, caption over the value cell that reads this byte

20/07.name: PAN

20/41.name: MIDI channel
20/41.basis: mixer strip MIDI cell; shown 1-01 to 2-16, and the manual gives the same 32 values. In a real dump the 32 parts read an unbroken 0..31 ramp
